card.name: Ending of proper names like Braintree
card.fires_on: The final piece of a proper name split into parts, mainly "intree" in Braintree Laboratories and "ree" in the river Spree. Weaker on endings of brand or tool names.

modes.label: Braintree company name
modes.description: The "intree" ending of Braintree before Laboratories in the SUPREP label.
modes.example: Pediatric use information is approved for Bra<<intree>> Laboratories, Inc.'s SUPREP B

modes.label: Place name ending
modes.description: The "ree" ending of the river name Spree.
modes.example: town, it is traversed by the river Sp<<ree>>. It borders the localities of Tier

card.plain: It lights up on the last part of a split-up name, especially Braintree, the maker of SUPREP.
